title: Zesty and Aerated Tunisian Gochugaru Candy Paella
description: A unique, indulgent and tangy Tunisian Paella dish featuring gochugaru and candy, suitable for macrobiotic diets.
instructions: In a large, oven-safe paella pan, heat coconut oil over medium-high heat.
Add gochugaru and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Add candy pieces and cook, stirring frequently, until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
Add paella rice and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes, covered.
In a separate bowl, whip almond milk until it becomes aerated and frothy.
Remove paella pan from heat and stir in almond milk mixture, orange zest, lemon juice, and salt.
Return paella pan to medium heat and cook, stirring constantly, until the rice is cooked and the liquid has been absorbed, about 5 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with additional candy pieces if desired.
